bartlett-1macc: John R. Bartlett, 1 Maccabees, Guides to Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha (1998)
doran-1macc: Robert Doran, "The First Book of Maccabees: Introduction, Commentary, and Reflections," in The New Interpreter's Bible, vol. 4 (1996)
schurer-vermes: Emil Schürer, The History of the Jewish People in the Age of Jesus Christ (175 B.C.–A.D. 135), revised and edited by Geza Vermes, Fergus Millar and Matthew Black, vol. 1 (1973)
vanderkam-high-priests: James C. VanderKam, From Joshua to Caiaphas: High Priests after the Exile (2004)
pesher-habakkuk: Pesher Habakkuk (1QpHab), a commentary on Habakkuk 1–2 from Qumran Cave 1, copied in the late first century BC; translated in Geza Vermes, The Complete Dead Sea Scrolls in English
cross-ancient-library: Frank Moore Cross, The Ancient Library of Qumran, 3rd ed. (1995)
groningen-hypothesis: Florentino García Martínez and Adam S. van der Woude, "A 'Groningen' Hypothesis of Qumran Origins and Early History," Revue de Qumrân 14 (1990): 521–541
stegemann-qumran: Hartmut Stegemann, Die Entstehung der Qumrangemeinde (1971), and The Library of Qumran (1993; English 1998)
murphy-oconnor-essenes: Jerome Murphy-O'Connor, "The Essenes and Their History," Revue Biblique 81 (1974): 215–244
polybius-histories: Polybius, Histories (second century BC), the fragments of books 31–33 and 39 on Demetrius I, Alexander Balas and Ptolemy VI
strabo-geography: Strabo, Geography (about AD 20), book 16 on Syria and Phoenicia, including the Eleutherus and the death of Ptolemy VI (16.2.8)
diodorus-32-33: Diodorus of Sicily, Library of History (first century BC), the fragments of books 32–33 on Alexander Balas, Ptolemy VI, Demetrius II and Tryphon
luther-preface-1macc: Martin Luther, Preface to the First Book of Maccabees (1533), in Luther's Works, vol. 35 (1960)
bickerman-god-maccabees: Elias J. Bickerman, The God of the Maccabees (1937; English translation 1979)
eshel-dss-hasmonean: Hanan Eshel, The Dead Sea Scrolls and the Hasmonean State (2008)
collins-beyond-qumran: John J. Collins, Beyond the Qumran Community: The Sectarian Movement of the Dead Sea Scrolls (2010)
ambrose-duties: Ambrose of Milan, On the Duties of the Clergy (De officiis, about AD 388–391), book 1, on courage in war
jerome-galeatus: Jerome, Preface to the Books of Samuel and Kings (the Prologus galeatus, about AD 391), where he says he found the first book of Maccabees in Hebrew
